title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Trio #06 (세로 띠·매끈 / 부채꼴·매끈 / 대각 띠·물결)

Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it.
